hooks.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '\.env(\.|"$|$)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: .env files must not be edited by Claude Code. Edit them manually.'; exit 1; fi
if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'packages/shared/index.js'; then echo 'REMINDER: You edited packages/shared/index.js. Run `npm run seed:permissions -w @buildflow/api` to reseed permissions.'; fi
if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'apps/api/src/(models|controllers)/'; then echo 'REMINDER: New model/controller created. Ensure it includes organizationId for multi-tenancy scoping.'; fi

if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'apps/api/.*\.js'; then STATUS=$(curl -sf http://localhost:5001/api/health 2>&1) && echo "API health check: OK - $STATUS" || echo 'API health check: UNREACHABLE (is the dev server running?)'; fi
